plays.title: Sac bunt fielded
plays.players: Taylor Walls, Logan Henderson, Jake Bauers
plays.description: Taylor Walls out on a sacrifice bunt, pitcher Logan Henderson to first baseman Jake Bauers. Victor Mesa Jr. to 2nd.
plays.coaching_point: Corners charge, the fielder calls the ball, and the throw goes to the covering fielder at 1B; take the sure out.
coach_notes: A pitcher-fielded bunt thrown to first is also a Pitcher Fielding Play (PFP).

segments.label: P: field & throw to 1B
segments.note: Wide shot; pitcher is small in frame.

plays.title: Sac bunt fielded
plays.players: Richie Palacios, David Hamilton, Brice Turang
plays.description: Richie Palacios out on a sacrifice bunt, third baseman David Hamilton to second baseman Brice Turang. Liam Hicks to 2nd.
plays.coaching_point: Corners charge, the fielder calls the ball, and the throw goes to the covering fielder at 1B; take the sure out.

segments.label: 3B: charge, field & throw
segments.note: Wide shot; 3B is small in frame.

plays.title: Sac bunt fielded
plays.players: Chandler Simpson, José Ramírez, Nathaniel Lowe
plays.description: Chandler Simpson out on a sacrifice bunt, third baseman José Ramírez to first baseman Nathaniel Lowe. Jorge Mateo to 2nd.
plays.coaching_point: Corners charge, the fielder calls the ball, and the throw goes to the covering fielder at 1B; take the sure out.
coach_notes: Ramírez gets a really good read and sees the bunt coming.
He's playing deep, charges down the middle from deep, and adjusts his line because the ball is rolling, then bare-hands it.

plays.title: Bunt DP 1-5-4
plays.players: Jake Rogers, Troy Melton, Hao-Yu Lee, Gleyber Torres
plays.description: Jake Rogers ground bunts into a double play, pitcher Troy Melton to third baseman Hao-Yu Lee to second baseman Gleyber Torres. Chase Meidroth out at 3rd. Tristan Peters to 2nd. Jake Rogers out at 1st.
plays.coaching_point: Pitcher fields the bunt, gets the lead out at 3rd, and 3B turns two to 2B covering 1st.
coach_notes: The bunt goes right back to the pitcher with men on 1st and 2nd. Get the lead out at 3rd, then turn two.

segments.label: P: field & throw to 3B
segments.note: Single wide shot from behind home; fielders are small.

segments.label: 3B: force at 3rd & throw to 1st
segments.note: 3B is at the edge of a wide shot.

plays.title: Lead runner at 3rd (C to 3B)
plays.players: Ryan McMahon, Gabriel Moreno, Nolan Arenado
plays.description: Ryan McMahon ground bunts into a force out, catcher Gabriel Moreno to third baseman Nolan Arenado. Austin Wells out at 3rd. Anthony Volpe to 2nd. Ryan McMahon to 1st.
plays.coaching_point: Bunt defense: catcher fields, reads the call ("three!"), and makes a quick throw to 3B, who is covering the bag for the force on the lead runner.
coach_notes: Tough play: the catcher fields a short, poorly-touched bunt and makes a leaping throw on the run to third. Great throw.

plays.title: Lead runner at 2nd (1B to SS)
plays.players: Zach McKinstry, Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Andrés Giménez
plays.description: Zach McKinstry ground bunts into a force out, first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. to shortstop Andrés Giménez. Spencer Torkelson out at 2nd. Zach McKinstry to 1st.
plays.coaching_point: Bunt defense: 1B charges, fields with two hands, and throws to SS covering 2B for the lead-runner force.
coach_notes: Hard bunt to first. The 1B goes after the lead runner at second.

segments.label: SS: cover 2B & receive for the force

plays.title: Pickoff 1B
plays.players: Pitcher Jake Irvin, Yohandy Morales
plays.description: Pitcher Jake Irvin picks off Juan Soto at 1st on throw to first baseman Yohandy Morales.
plays.coaching_point: Pitcher uses a quick, accurate pickoff move; 1B gives a low target and makes a quick tag.
coach_notes: Irvin moves his front leg first on the pickoff move.

plays.title: Pickoff 2B
plays.players: Pitcher George Kirby
plays.description: Pitcher George Kirby picks off Henry Bolte at 2nd on throw to shortstop J.P. Crawford.
plays.coaching_point: Pitcher and SS are timed on the daylight play; SS breaks to the bag and tags low.
coach_notes: George Kirby picks to second with a really good spin move.

segments.label: SS: break to the bag, receive & tag

plays.title: Pickoff caught stealing 2B
plays.players: Bo Bichette, Gunnar Henderson
plays.description: With Carson Benge batting, Bo Bichette picked off and caught stealing 2nd base, shortstop Gunnar Henderson.
plays.coaching_point: Runner is picked off and caught; the throw goes to the base ahead and fielders close the gap in the rundown.
coach_notes: Left-handed pitcher picks to first, the first baseman makes a really good play, then throws to second to get the runner.

segments.label: 1B: throw to 2B
segments.note: The camera cuts as the pickoff arrives, so the 1B catch itself is not shown; this replay starts with him turning to throw.

plays.title: Pickoff caught stealing 3B
plays.players: Cedric Mullins, Adley Rutschman, Trevor Story, Caleb Durbin
plays.description: Cedric Mullins picked off and caught stealing 3rd base, catcher Adley Rutschman to shortstop Trevor Story to third baseman Caleb Durbin.
plays.coaching_point: Runner caught off base: run him back, few throws, and tag with the ball in the bare hand inside the glove.
coach_notes: Quick play. The catcher's throw and the shortstop's exchange were both really good.

segments.label: SS: receive & exchange to 3B
segments.note: Wide shot; SS is small in frame.

plays.title: Rundown
plays.players: Moisés Ballesteros, Harry Ford, CJ Abrams, Brady House, Will Dion
plays.description: Moisés Ballesteros caught stealing 3rd base, catcher Harry Ford to shortstop CJ Abrams to third baseman Brady House to shortstop CJ Abrams to pitcher Will Dion. Christian Moore to 2nd.
plays.coaching_point: Rundown: run the runner back toward the base he came from, throw early and chest-high, and clear the lane after each throw.
coach_notes: Catcher-to-SS throw behind the runner on a missed bunt is a classic baseball play.
They get him in a rundown and get the out; the exchange saves it.

segments.label: C: throw behind the runner at 2B
segments.note: Camera switches to a wide shot during the throw; catcher is tiny.

segments.label: SS: receive, run him back & throw to 3B
SS (2nd touch): receive & throw to P covering 3B

plays.title: Rundown
plays.players: Brenton Doyle, Leo Bernal, Thomas Saggese, Alec Burleson, Masyn Winn
plays.description: Brenton Doyle caught stealing 2nd base, catcher Leo Bernal to second baseman Thomas Saggese to first baseman Alec Burleson to shortstop Masyn Winn.
plays.coaching_point: Rundown: ball-holder sprints at the runner with the ball up and shown, receivers close the gap, one throw if possible.
coach_notes: Base-running lesson: watch how the runner gets caught breaking on the ball in the dirt.
Once he knows he's out and the ball is going to the SS, he starts running at the shortstop.

segments.label: C: block the ball in the dirt & throw to 2B
segments.note: Throw happens across a camera cut.

segments.label: 2B: receive, run at the runner & throw to 1B
1B: receive, run him back & throw to SS

plays.title: Rundown
plays.players: Ryan Kreidler, John Schreiber, Anthony Volpe, Ryan McMahon, George Lombard Jr.
plays.description: Ryan Kreidler picked off and caught stealing 3rd base, pitcher John Schreiber to second baseman Anthony Volpe to third baseman Ryan McMahon to shortstop George Lombard Jr.
plays.coaching_point: Rundown off a pickoff: pitcher steps off and runs at the runner, then the infielders back each other up and finish with one late throw.
coach_notes: Pickoff to second: the pitcher throws to the second baseman.

segments.label: 3B: receive, run him back & throw to SS

plays.title: Rundown
plays.players: Cole Carrigg, Andrés Muñoz, Weston Wilson, J.P. Crawford
plays.description: Cole Carrigg caught stealing 3rd base, pitcher Andrés Muñoz to third baseman Weston Wilson to shortstop J.P. Crawford.
plays.coaching_point: Long rundown: keep the runner moving, everyone rotates to back up behind the throw, and the tagger catches it moving at the runner.
coach_notes: Good inside move to second. The runner doesn't commit back to second, breaks for third, and they catch him.
Really good play to draw out.

segments.label: 3B: receive, run him back & throw to SS

plays.title: Caught stealing 2B
plays.players: Cooper Pratt, Will Smith, Mookie Betts
plays.description: Cooper Pratt caught stealing 2nd base, catcher Will Smith to shortstop Mookie Betts.
plays.coaching_point: The middle infielder straddles the bag, catches, and makes a quick sweep tag low in front of the base.
coach_notes: High-and-outside fastball gave the runner a reason to go and set up a really easy pop for the catcher.
The throw is right on the money.

plays.title: Caught stealing 2B
plays.players: Jazz Chisholm Jr., Luis Campusano, Jake Cronenworth
plays.description: Jazz Chisholm Jr. caught stealing 2nd base, catcher Luis Campusano to second baseman Jake Cronenworth.
plays.coaching_point: The middle infielder straddles the bag, catches, and makes a quick sweep tag low in front of the base.
coach_notes: Campusano sets up one knee down (right knee up, left knee down) for a pitch outside.
When the runner goes he flips his stance (left knee up, right foot behind) to throw. That move is money.
The ball is pulled back and Chisholm is tagged on the arm. He's out.

segments.label: C: stance flip & throw
segments.note: Starts at Coach Cassady's 2.2 s stance-flip mark.

plays.title: Caught stealing 3B
plays.players: Nasim Nuñez, Will Smith, Max Muncy
plays.description: Nasim Nuñez caught stealing 3rd base, catcher Will Smith to third baseman Max Muncy.
plays.coaching_point: 3B gets to the bag early, receives at the front edge, and makes a quick tag down.
coach_notes: Catcher sets up outside looking for a momentum throw; the high-middle pitch holds him back a bit, but it's still a good momentum throw.
Runner: Nuñez gets his foot on the bag, then pulls it off. Keep contact on a dive.
3B: Muncy keeps the tag on and gets him when he comes off the bag. Never give up on a tag play.

segments.label: C: momentum throw to 3B
segments.note: Camera switches to a wide shot as he throws.

plays.title: Caught stealing 2B
plays.players: Bobby Witt Jr., Joe Mack, Otto Lopez
plays.description: Bobby Witt Jr. caught stealing 2nd base, catcher Joe Mack to shortstop Otto Lopez.
plays.coaching_point: The middle infielder straddles the bag, catches, and makes a quick sweep tag low in front of the base.
coach_notes: Mack is one knee down with the left knee up, receives, and pops straight from that spot without resetting.
The throw is downhill and 'on the money': not on the bag, but to the shortstop.
Lopez receives in front of the bag; the throw arrives about 4 feet up the line and meets Witt as he slides in.

segments.label: C: receive & pop from one knee
SS: receive in front of the bag & tag

plays.title: Caught stealing 3B
plays.players: Jackson Chourio, Carson Kelly, Alex Bregman
plays.description: Jackson Chourio caught stealing 3rd base, catcher Carson Kelly to third baseman Alex Bregman.
plays.coaching_point: 3B gets to the bag early, receives at the front edge, and makes a quick tag down.

plays.title: Caught stealing 2B
plays.players: José Caballero, Francisco Alvarez, Francisco Lindor
plays.description: José Caballero caught stealing 2nd base, catcher Francisco Alvarez to shortstop Francisco Lindor.
plays.coaching_point: The middle infielder straddles the bag, catches, and makes a quick sweep tag low in front of the base.
coach_notes: Catcher: right knee down; receives and pops up onto that same leg without resetting.
The throw is really up the line; Lindor gets the tag down with a really good swipe tag.
Finish the play: Lindor almost celebrated early with one hand up.

segments.label: C: receive & pop from the knee

categories.name: Infield-In & Runner on Third
intro: Infield-in alignment: 1B inside the cut taking away the 4-hole · 2B taking away the cheap shot up the middle · SS taking away the 5-hole · 3B playing the line.
P covers the ball up the middle. Hitters are looking low and hard, so you cover low and hard.

plays.title: Out at home
plays.players: Ben Williamson, Nathaniel Lowe, Patrick Bailey
plays.description: Ben Williamson reaches on a fielder's choice out, first baseman Nathaniel Lowe to catcher Patrick Bailey. Chandler Simpson out at home. Junior Caminero to 3rd.
plays.coaching_point: Infield in: field it, check the runner, and throw low to the catcher for the out at home.
coach_notes: The 1B plays inside the cut, taking away the 4-hole, handles the ball well, and makes a good throw.
The catcher is not in front of the plate as he receives. He comes from behind the plate, then puts his foot in front and swipe-tags.

segments.label: 1B: field & throw home
segments.note: Wide shot; 1B is small in frame.

segments.label: C: receive, step in & swipe tag

plays.title: Out at home
plays.players: Dansby Swanson, Caleb Durbin, Mickey Gasper
plays.description: Dansby Swanson reaches on a fielder's choice out, third baseman Caleb Durbin to catcher Mickey Gasper. Matt Shaw out at home. Michael Busch to 2nd.
plays.coaching_point: Infield in: field it, check the runner, and throw low to the catcher for the out at home.
coach_notes: The 3B is playing kind of deep, comes in well on the ball, makes a good transfer, and gets a receivable throw to the catcher.
The runner slides to the inside of the plate. The catcher's foot is in front of the plate and he swipe-tags (compare with INF01).

segments.label: C: receive in front of the plate & tag
